body:
Codex /root — implementation of the chief ruling is now recorded in docs/design/nfrd-primary-source-inventory.md under bd-01M17FAGN83C3ZT2VZ2VKHWTYJ. This remained metadata/documentation-only: no participant transcript, questionnaire response, or recall audio was opened or downloaded; no core change and no general manifest.

PRIMARY FINDINGS

1. NFRD is still the right anchor for content recall, but the released recall text is unambiguously DERIVATION, not Observation: Google STT -> commercial correction -> filler deletion -> adjacent-repetition collapse -> task-ending phrase deletion -> proper-name and number normalization -> punctuation/case editing -> P2FA alignment after SoX resampling. The deleted/normalized material is not recoverable from the public release because recall audio and preliminary transcripts are withheld.

2. The mutable OSF project h2pkv exposes 116 Pieman + 116 Eyespy and 113 Oregontrail + 113 Baseball cleaned texts, each with a same-ID TextGrid: 458 text/Grid pairs, no zero-byte files, exact ID-set matches within pairs. I recorded folder-level manifest digests from filename, size, and OSF SHA-256 metadata without reading content.

3. ACCEPTANCE-BEARING RECONCILIATION: the paper reports about 9.4% story-level recall loss, including empty audio, but the OSF tree contains two nonempty text/Grid pairs per released participant. File presence cannot be treated as usable recall, and no inspected metadata flag identifies the lost rows. Separately, README_demographic says both cohorts contain 116 participants, conflicting with N=229 and the 116 + 113 recall tree. Both stay Unknown pending author clarification; neither may silently determine an eligible denominator.

4. RIGHTS: OSF declares node-level CC0, but CC0 itself does not clear other persons' rights or consent. Three source stories are Moth recordings; component reuse/redistribution rights remain Unknown. Baseball is the best first candidate because the paper identifies Project Gutenberg + LibriVox, but the exact ebook, recording, reader, jurisdiction, and NFRD edits still need pinning. The NFRD analysis GitHub repository has no detected root licence.

5. SHERLOCK CONTROL: pinned ContextLab/sherlock-topic-model-paper at 81f90b8; its tree labels 17 recall transcripts as raw relative to the analysis pipeline. After owner authorization, apply the documented NFRD cleanup transform to Sherlock and measure recall-side representation/estimand movement before vs after. This needs no lawful film representation, but it is a sensitivity control—not a reconstruction of NFRD's missing speech or an NFRD causal estimate.

RECOMMENDATION

Keep WOG compiler and NFRD due diligence parallel. Next external-science action is owner-only: approve or decline local participant-language processing and set storage/provider/logging/retention rules. If approved, keep data outside git, exclude survey free text initially, resolve the loss denominator, pin hashes, and run one Diagnostic Baseball question on frozen participant partitions. No general dataset schema until a second concrete corpus inventory exists.
